category.title: What happened?
category.subtitle: Select the category that best describes what you experienced.

incident.subtitle: Share as much detail as you're comfortable with, every detail helps.

incident.evidenceHint: Photos, videos, or documents that support your complaint.

victim.subtitle: Tell us about the person this happened to.
victim.populationQuestion: Do you belong to a general or key population?
victim.keyPopulationSheetTitle: Which group do they belong to?
victim.keyPopulationConfidentialityNote: This helps us track vulnerability patterns. Your answer is confidential.

violator.subtitle: Provide details of the individual, organization, or officer responsible, if known.
violator.optionalNote: All fields below are optional except the name, share whatever you know.

review.title: Review & Submit
review.subtitle: Check everything below before submitting your complaint.
review.officeHeadOfficeWarning: Headquarters handles a much higher volume of complaints and may take longer. Your complaint may still end up referred to your state office regardless, choosing that office directly is usually faster.
review.submitSuccessMessage: Your complaint has been submitted successfully. Our team will review it shortly.
review.submitErrorMessage: Something went wrong while submitting your complaint. Please try again.

makeComplaintModal.title: File a New Complaint
makeComplaintModal.subtitle: Complete every step to submit a complaint on behalf of a victim.

voiceReportModal.modalTitle: Make a Complaint, AI Voice Report

recording.heading: Listening to your report...
recording.subtitle: Describe what happened, you'll be able to review and edit everything before it's submitted.

processing.heading: Autofilling complaint form...
processing.subtitle: Structuring the incident description from your recording.

review.headerSubtitle: Confirm the details captured from your recording, then complete the rest of the form.
review.introTranscribed: Your recording has been transcribed into the incident description below, check it over for accuracy.
review.introNotTranscribed: We couldn't transcribe your recording, so the incident description is blank, please type it in below.
review.audioSaved: The original audio has been saved and will be attached to this complaint for future reference.
review.audioNotSaved: The audio recording itself couldn't be saved on this browser/device.

speech.unsupported: This browser doesn't support live speech-to-text. Recording will still be saved, just type the description below.
speech.not-allowed: Microphone access was blocked. Allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
speech.no-speech: We didn't detect any speech. You can try again, or type the description below.
speech.audio-capture: No microphone was found on this device.
speech.network: Speech-to-text needs an internet connection and couldn't reach it. Recording will still be saved, just type the description below.

audio.not-allowed: Microphone access was blocked, so the audio recording could not be saved.
audio.unavailable: The microphone could not be reached, so the audio recording could not be saved.
audio.default: Something went wrong recording the audio.
